items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: These tunes were, you know, Gershwin and Irving Berlin and these guys, they wrote some pretty songs with nice chord changes

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s an interesting thought. The lyrics and actual chord progressions in those days, well I supposed we can sound dated, but there seemed to be more of a craft to the songwriting.

Yes. They are not just one chord, like they have one or two chords and like they have today. These tunes were, you know, Gershwin and Irving Berlin and these guys, they wrote some pretty songs with nice chord changes and I think it’s the little melodies to them that please the younger generation’s ear. I think that’s what it is.
